messages:
lina: Quick UX review — private setup networking step. I'm worried users don't understand why we ask for NAT vs IGW. Can we add a short sentence and an expandable rationale?

sam: +1. Hard drop-off in user testing when 'Internet access' field is vague. A single line explaining "needed for model downloads & telemetry" should help.

ada: Agreed. Also noticed the port probe errors are confusing — logs show ephemeral port failures. Maybe show 'outbound ports 1024-65535' in help.

matt: Suggest two microcopy options, inline: A) "Outbound internet required for fetching model layers and telemetry. Use NAT or route to a public gateway." B) "Model updates and support checks need outbound access. If you block egress, enable a NAT or add an IGW." Which is clearer?

lina: I prefer B — more action-oriented. But shorten 'support checks' to 'health checks'.

sam: Can we add a tooltip on the network diagram? On hover show "NAT = one public IP for many hosts; IGW = assign public IPs".

uxbot: Figma link: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/priv-wizard-network?node-id=234:12 (updated artboard with tooltip states)

ada: For accessibility: make the reason expandable via a <button aria-expanded> so screen readers see the change; add a live region update when probe status changes.

matt: Good call. Also fix focus: when user opens 'why is this needed' expand, shift focus to the panel header so keyboard users can tab through.

lina: Microcopy proposal update: final text — "Outbound access is required for model downloads and health checks. If you restrict egress, configure a NAT gateway or an Internet Gateway (IGW)." Any objections?

sam: No objections. Can we add a second-line help link "how to configure NAT" that opens docs in a new tab? Use external link icon.

ada: Probe error case — suggest the inline error show a machine-readable code and a short suggestion. Example:
```
Error: PROBE_EGRESS_BLOCKED
Try: allow outbound TCP ports 1024-65535 or configure a NAT gateway
```

lina: Love the code hint. UX note: show a copy-to-clipboard icon for the error snippet.

matt: One more: analytics team wants the default to be 'run a quick probe' checkbox checked. Anyone worried about noise?

sam: I'd leave it checked but add 'Run quick connectivity probe' with a tiny help icon explaining it only sends minimal telemetry.

lina: I'll iterate the artboard: condensed rationale, tooltip on diagram, error code UI, live-region for results, focus behavior, and copy-to-clipboard for logs. I'll drop in two copy lengths (short/long) so docs team can pick.

uxbot: Created design task #D-4123 and linked to PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/891

ada: I'll add the a11y tests to the setup wizard e2e suite — focus, live region, and keyboard nav.

sam: Thanks team :thumbsup:
